Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.item

Class RangedWeapon

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Item
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Equipment
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.Weapon
com.epitech.depthdiablo.item.RangedWeapon
All Implemented Interfaces:
Attack, BuildModifier
Direct Known Subclasses:
Bow, Staff
public abstract class RangedWeapon extends Weapon
A weapon that attacks from afar: each attack fires one projectile that flies Weapon.getRange() pixels (GDD 1.3.1). Its families are Bow and Staff; the real weapons extend one of them, so the desktop picks the attack sound by family (GDD 4.2.2).

Pattern: Template Method. attack(com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Character, float, com.epitech.depthdiablo.engine.World) checks, starts the cooldown and adds the shot to the world; createProjectile(com.epitech.depthdiablo.entity.character.Character, float, com.epitech.depthdiablo.engine.World) is the hook that says which shot it is.

  • Constructor Details

    • RangedWeapon

      protected RangedWeapon(String id, String nameKey, String spriteId, Rarity rarity, int price, int attackBonus, float attackSpeed, float range, float projectileSpeed, String projectileSpriteId)
      Creates a ranged weapon.
      Parameters:
      id - the item's key in the data files
      nameKey - the translation key of its name
      spriteId - the picture the renderer draws for it
      rarity - its loot tier; never Rarity.CONSUMABLE
      price - its shop price in coins; 0 means free
      attackBonus - the flat bonus added to the holder's ATTACK when it builds; 0 or more
      attackSpeed - its base attack speed, multiplied into the holder's ATTACK_SPEED; above 0 and finite
      range - how far its projectile flies, in pixels; above 0 and finite
      projectileSpeed - how fast its projectile flies, in pixels per second; above 0 and finite
      projectileSpriteId - the picture of its projectiles, pointing right; not blank
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if a text or the rarity is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if a value is out of range

    • attack

      public final void attack(Character owner, float aimDegrees, World world)
      Fires one projectile towards the aim and starts the owner's cooldown. Either all of it happens or nothing does: a wrong argument leaves the owner's cooldown untouched.
      Parameters:
      owner - the character who shoots; it must be able to attack now
      aimDegrees - the direction of the shot, in degrees (0 = right, 90 = up)
      world - the world the projectile flies in
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if the aim is not a finite number
      IllegalStateException - if the owner cannot attack now (see Character.canAttack())

    • createProjectile

      protected abstract Projectile createProjectile(Character owner, float aimDegrees, World world)
      Makes the projectile of one shot, starting on the owner and flying towards the aim at getProjectileSpeed() for getProjectileLifetimeTicks() ticks.
      Parameters:
      owner - the character who shoots
      aimDegrees - the direction of the shot, in degrees, already checked as finite
      world - the world the projectile flies in
      Returns:
      the new projectile, not yet in the world
